result.topic_en: An induction proof of a general law for the n-th derivative of φx with respect to u, expressed as an (n−1)-th derivative with respect to t involving ξ^n (a Lagrange-inversion-type formula), followed by a long division of 6789548 by 4.
result.transcription:
Allgemein wenn
$\frac{d^n\varphi x}{(du)^n} = \left(\frac{\partial^{n-1}\xi^n\left(\frac{d\varphi x}{dt}\right)}{dt^{n-1}}\right)$ so ist nach u diff.
$\left(\frac{d^{n+1}\varphi x}{du^{n+1}}\right) = \frac{\partial^n \xi^n \frac{d\varphi x}{dt}}{dt^{n-1}\cdot du}$ u. wenn man auf der rechten
Seite nach u zuerst differentiirt
$= \left(\frac{\partial^{n-1}\left(n\xi^{n-1}\frac{d\xi}{du}\frac{\partial\varphi x}{\partial t^{1}}\ \xi^n\frac{d^2\varphi x}{dt\,du}\right)}{dt^{n-1}}\right)$
oder nach den gehörigen Substitutionen
$= \frac{\partial^{n-1}\left((n+1)\xi^n\frac{\partial\varphi x}{\partial t}\frac{\partial\xi}{dt} + \xi^n\frac{d^2\varphi t}{dt^2}\right)}{dt^{n-1}}$
$= \frac{\partial^n\xi^{n+1}\frac{\partial\varphi x}{dt}}{dt^n}$ Also das Gesetz allgemein
bewiesen.

methods.what: Induction hypothesis: formula expressing the n-th derivative of φx with respect to u as the (n−1)-th t-derivative of ξ^n times dφx/dt (Lagrange/Bürmann inversion type formula)
Inductive step: differentiating both sides with respect to u, interchanging the order of differentiation on the right side, and substituting
methods.quote:
